lemmas.primary_translation: be tired of / have had enough of something or someone

definitions.translation: be tired of (lit. have/get something right up one’s throat)

definitions.text: ha fått nok av noe eller noen
definitions.translation: have had enough of something or someone

examples.no: jeg har fått jobben helt opp i halsen
examples.en: i'm sick and tired of the job

examples.no: de har journalistene opp i halsen
examples.en: they've had enough of the journalists
